interpolation_audit.fit_meaning: Discovery interpolation approximation, not heldout prediction or a learned causal law

limitations: Each prototype is one batch retained-copy mean, not an identified molecular pose mode.
Two distances cannot reconstruct all selected structures or chemical graphs.
Targets are retrospective selection associations, not physical optima.

regularization.origin: Pilot numerical assumptions; covariance is equal-batch mean of same-time within-unguided-batch covariances
